# EP-098: Requirements

## Requirements

### REQ-98.001 — Vague requirement
The system should efficiently handle data as needed.

### REQ-98.002 — Passive voice
Data is processed by the system when received.

### REQ-98.003 — Multiple thoughts
THE system SHALL log events and SHALL send notifications and SHALL update cache.

### REQ-98.004 — Valid EARS
WHEN a request arrives, THE system SHALL respond within 200ms.
